# bundle validate confirms a scaffolded bundle is valid
mkdir project
cd project

exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input bundle init --yes
stderr 'Created musher.yaml'

exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input bundle validate
stderr 'Bundle is valid'

# JSON mode returns structured output
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input --json bundle validate
stdout '"valid"'
stdout '"assetCount"'
